# Brightluxx — Premium LED Display Solutions

> https://brightluxx.com

## Company Overview

Brightluxx is a premium LED display manufacturer and solutions provider headquartered in Dubai, UAE. Since 2005, we have designed, manufactured, supplied, and installed LED display systems across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, and the broader Middle East/GCC region.

We serve architects, interior designers, contractors, retail chains, hospitality groups, government entities, and event companies with end-to-end LED display solutions — from design consultation through manufacturing, installation, and after-sales support.

## Product Families

### LumiMorph — Fine-Pitch MicroLED
- **LumiMorph Elite**: Ultra-premium MicroLED (0.4–0.9mm pixel pitch), COB technology, for luxury residences, corporate boardrooms, and museums
- **LumiMorph Grande**: Large-format fine-pitch LED (1.2–2.5mm), for lobbies, event halls, and immersive installations
- **LumiMorph Mini**: Compact fine-pitch displays for meeting rooms, retail, and gallery walls

### NaturaTex — Texture Screen Technology
- Nano-optical technology with COB LED
- Displays blend seamlessly with architectural surfaces when off, show stunning visuals when on
- **HoloVeil**: Transparent holographic LED film for glass facades

### SignaTouch — Interactive Digital Signage
- **Touch Kiosk**: Interactive kiosk displays for retail, hospitality, and wayfinding
- **Smart Signage**: AI-powered digital signage with CMS
- **Self-Service**: Self-service terminals for ordering, check-in, and information

### GlassMorph — Smart Glass & Transparent LED
- **Smart Film**: Switchable privacy glass (PDLC technology)
- **LED Film**: Transparent LED film for glass surfaces
- **Media Glass**: LED-integrated glass panels
- **Flying Display**: Frameless transparent LED for suspended installations

### PixelVue — Standard & Specialty LED
- Indoor poster displays, flip signs, video walls, modular video bricks
- Products: iPoster, iFlip, UltraFlip, Unity, VideoBrick

## Applications & Use Cases

- **Retail**: Digital signage, video walls, interactive kiosks, window displays
- **Hospitality**: Hotel lobby displays, restaurant menu boards, event screens
- **Corporate**: Boardroom displays, reception walls, meeting room screens
- **Architecture**: Facade lighting, media walls, transparent displays
- **Entertainment**: Concert/event screens, immersive art installations, home cinema
- **Government**: Command centers, public information displays, smart city signage
- **Transport**: Airport displays, metro signage, drive-thru menu boards
